name: How much should I expect to pay for backsplash tile installation?
description: Small repairs cost less, while full or custom installs cost more. Tile type, prep work, and pattern complexity are the biggest price drivers.

mainEntity.name: How much should I expect to pay for backsplash tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost usually depends on square footage, tile material, layout complexity, and how much prep or removal is involved. Denver-area pricing commonly ranges from a few hundred dollars for small repairs or small runs to several thousand for larger, custom, or full replacement projects, especially when intricate patterns or premium materials are used.
